recommended.name: save-then-explicitly-discard-LTO-partition-metadata
recommended.mechanism: Use lld --lto-obj-path to retain the generated LTO object as evidence, require .llvm_sympart to exist there with the expected non-ALLOC classification, and name it explicitly in /DISCARD/ so orphan-handling=error remains globally unchanged. The final ELF retains the relocation sections needed by the data-reference gate; .llvm_sympart itself is compiler partition metadata, not a relocation record.
recommended.why: This preserves hard orphan failure, makes the exceptional input observable, and avoids pretending internal LTO bookkeeping is product proof payload.

exact_warning_wrapper.mechanism: Run orphan-handling=warn and promote every warning except the exact .llvm_sympart diagnostic to a wrapper error, followed by a total post-link section inventory.
exact_warning_wrapper.why_not_first: Log parsing would replace a native linker hard error with a wrapper convention.
